preconditions.description: The number of pixels of each color must be non-negative.
There must be at least one pixel in Flatland.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 if (a > 0 and b > 0 and c > 0) else min(a, b, c)
postconditions.description: If all three colors have at least one pixel, it is impossible to make all pixels the same color, so return -1. Otherwise, the minimum number of fights needed is the smallest count of any one color.
